items.docs:
List the reports available to the authenticated user: built-in reports, the user's personal reports, and organizational reports.

Insight entries whose feature flags are not enabled for your organization are omitted from the `insights` layout.

Create a custom report with your own selection of insight entries. Set `organizational` to `true` to share the report with every user in your organization instead of keeping it personal.

Reports created through the API are always custom reports: the report-level `builtIn` flag is set only by Syntage and cannot be set through the API.
Retrieve a report by ID. Use the report ID as the `uri` path segment when requesting a PDF download with the [Exports API](/api-reference/exports/export-data).

Update a custom report's name, insight layout, or organizational visibility.

Built-in reports cannot be updated. Personal reports can only be updated by their owner; organizational reports can only be updated by an admin.

Delete a custom report.

Built-in reports cannot be deleted. Personal reports can only be deleted by their owner; organizational reports can only be deleted by an admin.
